strings.%s, 기다리고 있었습니다. 저는 스승이신 지스카드 님의 제자인 유란이라: %s, I've been waiting for you. My name is Yuran, a disciple of Master Ziskad. Um, %s, are you all right? You look a little exhausted...
I've come such a long way to see her...
strings.이런 말씀 드리기 죄송합니다. 지금 이리스 님은 연합 본부에 계시지 않아: I'm sorry to tell you this, but Lady Iris isn't at the alliance headquarters right now.
strings.지금 사정이 있으니 조금만 기다려주시겠습니까? 금방 만날 수 있을 테니…: There are circumstances at the moment. Could you wait a little? You'll be able to see her soon...
strings.실망하시는 점도 이해하지만, 지금 이리스 님 또한 이리스 님대로 준비를: I understand your disappointment, but Lady Iris is also making preparations of her own.
strings.무슨 준비를 하고 있는지 물어봐도 될까요?: May I ask what she's preparing for?
strings.이리스 님은 수련의 숲으로 가셨습니다. 그곳에서 수련 중입니다. 얻은 힘: Lady Iris has gone to the Training Forest. She's training there... learning to make the power she's gained truly her own.
strings.그러면 수련의 숲에 가면 이리스를 만날 수 있는 건가요?: Then if I go to the Training Forest, can I see Iris?
strings.정 그러고 싶으시면 수련의 숲에 가시죠. 하지만, 가시는 길이 결코 쉽지: If you're so determined, then go to the Training Forest. But the journey will be far from easy.
strings.후우, 그래서 이리스 님을 만나면 제일 뭘 하고 싶으신가요?: Sigh... What is the first thing you want to do when you see Lady Iris?
First, I want to ask if she's been well.
strings.이리스에게 무슨 말을 해야 고민이에요. 이리스가 저에게 무슨 말을 해줄지: I'm struggling to think of what to say to her. I don't know what she'll say to me either...
strings.아, 혼잣말이 길었네요. 죄송해요. 아, 그건 그렇고 수련의 숲에 가려면: Oh, I've been talking to myself for too long. Sorry. Anyway, how do I get to the Training Forest?
strings.제릭스 님께서 친절히 수련의 숲에 대해 이야기해주실 겁니다. 저기 흰 옷: Jerix will gladly tell you about it. The person in white over there... Already gone.
strings.(잘못된 자가 아니길 비는 수밖에….): (All I can do is hope this isn't the wrong person...)
strings.넌 뭐지? 처음 보는데…. 결계가 열려 들어왔다면 분명 지스카드 님의 허: Who are you? I haven't seen you before... If the barrier opened to let you in, you must have Lord Ziskad's permission. Then you're the adventurer Lady Iris mentioned.
strings.네, 이리스가 말한 모험가 맞아요. 이리스는 지금 어디에 있죠? 그리고,: Yes, I'm the adventurer she mentioned. Where is Iris now? And, and...
strings.답답하군. 이리스 님을 만나려면 훈련장으로 가야지. 일단 가서 진에게 출: How tiresome. If you want to see Lady Iris, you need to go to the training grounds. First, get permission to enter from Jin.
That's all. Don't make me go to any more trouble.
Why are you still here? I'm a busy person, and I went out of my way to make time for you... Jin is over there.
Oh, all right. I'll go right away. Thank you, Jerix.
strings.제릭스 님 목소리가 커서 말이지. 이야기는 다 들었다. 이리스 님을 찾고: Jerix has a loud voice, you see. I heard everything. You're looking for Lady Iris... She went to the training grounds. By now, I imagine she's on the Floating Island.
strings.부유섬이요? 그곳은 어떻게 갈 수 있죠?: The Floating Island? How do I get there?
There's a path farther inside. Take it. But there's something you should be careful about.
strings.수련하는 곳인데 굳이 조심할 필요가 있나요?: It's a place for training. Is there really anything to be careful about?
strings.아무것도 몰라서 하는 말이군. 그곳은 전사들을 위해 준비된 곳인데, 일종: You say that because you know nothing about it. It's a place prepared for warriors, and it has rules of its own.
Does it? I'd rather learn the rules when I get there...
strings.제가 마음이 급해서요. 허가증을 내주시면 안될까요?: I'm in a hurry. Could you just give me permission to enter?
strings.그러면 어쩔 수 없지. 직접 안을 경험하면서 그곳의 룰을 익혀라. 나쁜: Then so be it. Experience it for yourself and learn the rules as you go. It won't be a bad experience... provided you can endure it.
strings.자, 훈련장으로 가는 걸 허락한다. 지금부터 들어가도 좋아. 그곳의 시련: Very well. You have permission to enter the training grounds. You may go in now. I hope you'll endure all its trials and return as a truly accomplished warrior.
strings.여기까지 오신 걸 모험가님은 혹시 이리스 님을 만나러 오신 분? 더욱 더: Having come this far, could you be the adventurer who's here to see Lady Iris? You must want to go even deeper. Hehe...
strings.네, 맞아요. 혹시 제 이야기를 들으셨나요?: Yes, that's right. Have you heard about me?
strings.맞아요. 이리스 님께서 말씀하셨거든요. 모험가 한 분이 방문한다면 친절: Yes. Lady Iris told me about you. She asked me to speak kindly to a certain adventurer if one came to visit.
You've done well to come this far, but rules are rules, so please follow my instructions. Even if you're the person Lady Iris mentioned, this is still the Training Forest.
Just like the people from many different guilds who've come here to prove themselves. Now, off you go.
strings.후우, 진 님께서 말씀하셨던 룰이 이런 것이었군요. 수련의 숲에서 서로: Phew... So these are the rules Jin mentioned. Fight one another in the Training Forest and win...
strings.네, 그게 이 수련의 숲의 룰이에요. 대륙을 어지럽히는 데이모스 교단,: Yes, those are the rules of this forest. The Deimos cult that throws the continent into turmoil, the demons and their kin targeting Lady Iris and humanity...
strings.그 외에도 알 수 없는 위협들이 가득한 세계를 지키기 위해서 지스카드 님: Lord Ziskad prepared this place to help protect a world filled with those and countless unknown threats.
Many warriors have emerged from here and fought against evil for a long time. I've seen those warriors, but you seem a little different.
strings.어쩌면 검신이라 불리는 지스카드 님처럼 되실 수도 있어요. 지금도 많은: Perhaps you could become someone like Lord Ziskad, who is called the Sword God. Even now, many people train hard and dream of becoming a Sword God. Who knows what will happen? Hehe...
strings.그러기 위해선 거쳐야 할 게 많아요. 실력도 실력이지만 운도 따라야 하고: You'll have to overcome much to get there. Skill matters, of course, but you'll need luck as well.
I've talked too much. I meant to tell you about Lady Iris...
strings.저는 마법사, 신을 믿는 교단의 사람과는 조금 다른 형태의 일을 하는 사: I'm a mage. My work is a little different from that of people in religious orders who believe in gods, so I may say things that sound unkind about Lady Iris.
Please forgive me for that in advance.
It's all right. I understand that you're saying those things out of concern for Iris.
Thank you for understanding. Then I'll continue.
strings.이리스 님은 신이 아닌 인간으로 태어나신 분…. 마왕을 느끼고 쓰러뜨렸지: Lady Iris was born a human, not a god... She sensed the Demon King and defeated him, but then realized that something about her choice was different from what she'd expected.
strings.자신이 원했을 수도 있고, 원하지 않았을 수도 있던 곳에 갇혀 지내셨어요: She lived trapped in a place she may or may not have wished to be. Then someone called to her, and she was able to leave.
strings.그리고 나머지는 모험가님도 아시다시피 세레스 신전에서 세레스 님의 힘을: As you know, she then gained Lady Seres's power at the Temple of Seres, earning the right to succeed her.
strings.그 자격을 제대로 받아들이고 여신이 되시려면 계속해서 수련을 하셔야 해요: To fully accept that right and become a goddess, she must keep training. She has to make that power entirely her own and learn to wield it.
strings.그런데 슈가 님은 이리스가 어디 있었다는 걸 아시는 거죠?: But Shuga, how do you know where Iris was?
strings.어? 제가 지금 무슨 이야길 한 거죠? 어? 뭐지? 잠깐 내가 아닌 것: Huh? What was I just talking about? Huh? What? For a moment, I felt as if I wasn't myself... All sorts of things happen in the Training Forest, so don't worry too much about it.
strings.여기 공기가 묘하게 이상하던데, 정말 괜찮으신 거 맞아요?: The air here does feel strangely unsettling. Are you really all right?
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 그러니까 계속 수련에 힘써 주세요. 아, 이리스 님은 부: I'm fine. Please keep working hard at your training. Oh, Lady Iris went to the Floating Island, so you should be able to see her there.
Hurry along. And give my regards to Bilbradha.
strings.네, 네. 일단 가보긴 하겠지만 그래도…. 그러면 진짜 가볼게요. 고마웠: All right, all right. I'll go, though I'm still... Well, I'd better be off. Thank you.
strings.(슈가가 부유섬 안쪽으로 향하는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라보다가 한숨을: (Shuga stares at %s's back as the adventurer heads deeper into the Floating Island, then sighs.)
strings.후우, 자주 오시면 안 된다고 말씀드렸잖아요. 이리스 님이 걱정된다고 하: Sigh... I told you that you shouldn't visit so often. Even if you're worried about Lady Iris, this puts me in a difficult position.
Maybe it's because I haven't lost in so long. I was speechless for a moment. Wow...
...I've seen plenty of reactions, but this is a first. I don't quite know what to say.
strings.길게 말하지 않을게. 졌으니까 네가 하고 싶은 대로 해. 이곳의 룰은 원: I'll keep it short. I lost, so do whatever you want. Usually, I make the rules here, but since you won, I'll let you decide this time.
strings.그런 건 생각해보지 않아서 괜찮아요. 여기 온 건 이리스를 만날 수 있을: That's all right. I hadn't thought about that. I came because I thought I'd be able to see Iris. Oh, and Shuga sends her regards.
strings.안부는 무슨…. 어제도 식사를 같이 했는데…. 아, 이리스? 이리스 언니: Her regards? We had dinner together just yesterday... Oh, Iris? You mean Iris, my big sis?
strings.호, 당신이 이리스 언니를 만나러 왔다는 사람이구나…. 꿈에서 본 이야기: Oh, so you're the one who came to see her... She told me about what she saw in her dreams, and I think you're the one.
strings.(꿈…. 이리스는 꿈에서 나를 지켜보고 있었던 거구나.): (Her dreams... So Iris has been watching me in her dreams.)
Oh, right. Where is Iris now? I heard she was here...
Decide on a rule first. Then I'll tell you. Even if you can't think of one, just pick anything.
strings.후우, 어쩔 수 없죠. 시간 날때마다 부유섬 한바퀴 돌면서 청소하고 그래: Sigh. Fine, then. Whenever you have time, make a round of the Floating Island and clean it up. It's a mess from all the guilds using it.
Ugh, there are people who do that already... Hmph. Fine, I'll do it. Happy now?
Now please tell me where Iris is.
strings.언니는 독안개 늪지로 갔어. 부유섬보다는 독안개 늪지의 수련이 더 나을: She went to the Poison Mist Swamp. She decided training there would be better than on the Floating Island.
strings.그곳에선 약점이나 극복해야 하는 것이 환영으로 나타나. 그 환영을 물리칠: There, your weaknesses and the things you need to overcome appear as illusions. If you can defeat those illusions, you can overcome anything.
I'll have to meet her and talk to her.
strings.이리스 언니는 그곳에서 계속해서 버티고 있어. 자신이 약한 걸 이겨내고: Iris keeps enduring it there. She wants to overcome her weaknesses, but it doesn't seem easy.
I've had to carry her away after she collapsed at the entrance more than once or twice.
strings.잘 챙겨줘. 인간의 삶이 외롭지 않도록…. 그리고 여신이 되면 더 외로워: Take good care of her. So her human life won't be lonely... And because she may become even lonelier once she's a goddess.
strings.네…, 이리스는 행복해져야 해요. 그래야 하는 사람이니까. 고마워요, 그: Yes... Iris deserves to be happy. She's someone who should be happy. Thank you. I'll go now.
strings.아, 맞다. 거기도 여기처럼 위험하다고 하려고 했는데…. 에이, 뭐 알아: Oh, right. I was going to say it's dangerous there too... Oh well. I'm sure they'll manage...
strings.%s? %s, 맞아? 여기까지 온 거야? 정말로?: %s? Is that really you, %s? You made it all the way here? Really?
strings.나, 맞아. 정말 오랜만에 우리 만나네. 무웬, 반가워. 그동안 어떻게: It's me. It's been so long since we saw each other. It's good to see you, Muwen. How have you been? How did you get to the East Land? I... I...
So much has happened. Let's take our time catching up later...
strings.지금 여기엔 어떻게 있는 거야?: What are you doing here now?
strings.나와 조에는 오랫동안 이리스를 찾아다녔어. 그동안 %s, 네가 있던 곳도: Zoe and I have been searching for Iris for a long time. We even visited places you'd been, %s, but we must have kept missing each other.
strings.그러다 소문을 듣고 우리도 이리스를 찾아 여기까지 오게 됐어. 온갖 우연: Then we heard rumors and followed Iris all the way here. There were all sorts of coincidences, but it must all have been the goddess's guidance.
strings.그런데 지금 여기 무웬 밖에 없는 거야? 다른 분들이 있다고 들었는데,: But are you the only one here now, Muwen? I heard there were others. Where did they go?
strings.모르겠어. 일단 지스카드 님 말씀으로 우리는 여기서 이리스의 수련을 돕고: I'm not sure. For now, Lord Ziskad has us helping with Iris's training here. Though all we really do is hurry her outside whenever she faints...
strings.벨로쉬 님은 어디론가 사라졌고, 프로즌 님은 북쪽으로 가셨어. 데이모스: Lord Belosh disappeared somewhere, and Lord Frozen went north. He said he needed to investigate the Deimos cult's movements...
The others went to help with various incidents around the East Land.
strings.아, 지금 이게 문제가 아니다! 내가 오랜만에 만나서 반가운 마음에 깜빡: Oh, this isn't what matters right now! I was so happy to see you after so long that I forgot...
Iris is in danger. If we leave her, she'll be swallowed by the darkness inside her again.
strings.독안개 늪지에서 약점이나 극복할 수 있는 것들을 볼 수 있지만, 그건 점: The Poison Mist Swamp shows you your weaknesses and the things you must overcome, but they gradually fill you with fear.
strings.이겨내지 못하면 침식되고 말아. 아무리 단단한 바위라도 파도에 조금씩 깎: If you can't overcome them, they eat away at you. Like waves slowly wearing down even the hardest rock. Yuran said it becomes more dangerous every time you fail to defeat them.
strings.마왕이야…. 이리스의 두려움, 마왕. 옳다고 믿었던 자신의 선택이 다른: The Demon King... That's what Iris fears. She's afraid because the choice she believed was right brought about a different result.
strings.우리들은 이리스의 선택이 최선이었다고 생각해…. 이리스에게 너무 가혹한: We think Iris made the best choice she could... Fate has been far too cruel to her. Sometimes it makes me want to blame someone, no matter who it is.
I think I understand a little. Iris...
Oh, %s. We can't stand around like this. Sorry for talking so much.
strings.나는 여기서 그때의 기억을 품은 악몽이 오지 못하게 막고 있을게. 이런: I'll stay here and stop the nightmares carrying memories of that time from getting through. Even someone like me wants to help her. Go! Hurry!
strings.이리스, 이리스. 제발 말 좀 들으래이. 이러다 니 큰일난다. 내가 뭐라: Iris, Iris! Please, listen to me! Keep this up and you'll be in serious trouble! What did I tell you? Please, think about your own health!
strings.쫌! 이거 조에 목소리다, 조에? 조에 거기 있어?: Come on... That's Zoe's voice! Zoe? Zoe, are you there?
strings.%s, %s, 맞나? 여기 무슨 일이고, 아, 이게 아이지. 지금 그게: %s? Is that you, %s? What're you doing here? No, wait, that's not important right now! No matter what I say, Iris won't wake up, like she can't hear a thing!
strings.이리스? 그런데 이리스가 왜? 아, 침식!! 이리스, 위험해!! 일어나!: Iris? What's wrong with her? Oh, the darkness!! Iris, you're in danger!! Wake up! Wake up, I said!! W-wait... What's that appearing right in front of me?
strings.(두려워, 무서워, 도, 도망가고 싶은 감정이 느껴져. 이리스, 이리스는: (I'm afraid. Terrified. I feel like r-running away. Iris... Have you been carrying all these feelings this whole time?)
strings.…이리스, 버텨줘. 아주 잠깐이면 끝날 거야. 네 선택이 틀리지 않았다는: ...Iris, hold on. It'll only take a moment. I'll show you that your choice wasn't wrong... Just hold on a little longer.
Iris, wake up!! I'm here now. Wake up from this fear!
Choen, Kazno... I trusted you... Don't do this... I... I... I never wanted this...
strings.제발…. 제발, 내 선택은…. 내가 믿었던 건…. 으아아아아아악!!: Please... Please, my choice... What I believed in... Aaaaaaaah!!
strings.이리스, 이리스!! 정신 차려!! 이리스!! 이리스!! 정신 차려!! 제: Iris, Iris!! Wake up!! Iris!! Iris!! Wake up!! Please!! This won't work. I need to get her out of here quickly. But... why is Ull here?
I've come to collect Iris on my master's orders. Stand aside.
Well, then I have no choice. Go to sleep...
